+title: 'ACPA-19d: Pass the ToolMode to Skills (SK-7a): SkillsToolContext and SkillsRegistry'
+---
+## What
+Split from ^xfeamnv (ACPA-19b) on 2026-11-10, with the agreement of testudoapp-75. Spec: ACPA-19 (TestudoApp/features/packages/foundationmodels-acpagent.md). Decision D128 (d): in `sandboxed` mode there are no skill scripts.
+
+External dependency: SK-7a (FoundationModelsSkills ^3npmrkb, session `foundationmodelsskills-f7`). It adds a REQUIRED `mode` parameter to `SkillsToolContext` and `SkillsRegistry`. Do not start until SK-7a is pushed. Agree the time of the dependency bump with `foundationmodelsskills-f7`.
+
+1. Update the FoundationModelsSkills dependency (`swift package update`).
+2. `Sources/FoundationModelsACPAgent/Tools/ToolCatalog.swift` `makeSkillsSource`: pass the mode of the agent (from ^xfeamnv) to each `SkillsRegistry(...)` call. Keep `SkillsRegistry(stack:)`; do not use `SkillsRegistry(roots:)`.
+3. Pass the mode to each `SkillsToolContext` (the skills tool of the root session and of the agent runs, `AgentsComposition.swift`).
+4. Skills SK-6a (c04d4cc) made `onReload` non-optional, and `commandUpdates` is never nil. Remove the dead `nil` branch in `Sources/FoundationModelsACPAgent/Commands/CommandRegistry.swift` ~336-337. Change the doc text at `ToolCatalog.swift` ~678 and `SessionSetup.swift` ~1062 that says "`watch: true` makes `commandUpdates` non-nil".
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] In `sandboxed` mode, a skill that has a script gives no script operation in the session.
+- [ ] In `open` mode, skill scripts work as before.
+- [ ] Each `SkillsRegistry` and `SkillsToolContext` call gives the mode of the agent.
+- [ ] No dead `nil` branch for `commandUpdates` stays.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsACPAgentTests/ToolModeTests.swift`: compose in `sandboxed` mode with a skill that has a script, and confirm that no script operation is in the session. Compose in `open` mode, and confirm that the script is there.
+- [ ] `swift test` passes with no warnings.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #step1
\ No newline at end of file
